data.reportText: Eli Lilly and Company Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  10/29/2026 before market open.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  4 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $9.83.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $7.02.
